MistakeIssue.description:
One thing a judge found wrong: a critique issue, an accuracy finding, a gate finding, a sync problem, a
validation error or a user's change request.

code.description: what kind of mistake, for grouping: V-B3 · accuracy:FALSE · layout: OVERLAP …
code.title: Code

severity.description: basic/good/great, ERROR/WARN, or the request's kind
severity.title: Severity

target.description: the scene, clip or file it is about
target.title: Target

MistakeIssue.title: MistakeIssue

description:
One row of a run's mistakes.jsonl: a judgement of an agent's output that would otherwise be overwritten (an
accuracy review, a build's gates, a preview's sync, a file that failed validation). Critique rounds, refactors and
change requests keep their own history and are read from their files when the report is made.

loop.description: review:script · review:plan · build · sync · validation · critique:<kind> · request
loop.title: Loop

agent.description: whose output was judged (the agent that owns the fix)
agent.title: Agent

attempt.description: the loop's failures in a row, as counted in state.json
attempt.title: Attempt

refactor.description: what was changed in response, when recorded (changes.json)
refactor.title: Refactor

title: MistakeEvent
